class.name: Global
class.brief_description: [color=red](Not user creatable)[/color] An autoloaded scene in UT-Godot-Engine. Used to store engine settings and global variables. The (res://Core/autoload/global.tscn) scene is set as an autoload scene.
class.description:
A core system node of UT-Godot-Engine that globally manages player state, game progress, inventory, settings, and more. It is a singleton object accessible from all scenes.
This is a system node registered as AutoLoad. Do not create it directly, access it via [code]global[/code].
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: check_level_up
method.description:
Checks if the player can level up with their current experience points.
If the level-up conditions are met, automatically increases level, max HP, and attack power and returns true. If level-up is not possible, returns false.
Typically called after battle completion or when gaining experience.

method.name: disable_input
method.description:
Disables a specific input key.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Name of the input action to disable (e.g., "ut_confirm", "ut_cancel")
Disabled inputs can be checked with [method has_input_disabled] and re-enabled with [method enable_input].
Used to restrict input during cutscenes or specific situations.

method.name: enable_input
method.description:
Re-enables an input key that was disabled with [method disable_input].
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Name of the input action to enable
Re-enabling an already enabled key causes no problems.

method.name: has_input_disabled
method.description:
Checks if a specific input key is disabled.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Name of the input action to check
Returns true if the input was disabled with [method disable_input]. Used for conditional branching in input processing logic.

method.name: alert
method.description:
Displays an alert message box on screen. Functions the same as [method OS.alert].
[b]Parameters:[/b] • text: Message content to display • title: Title of the message box (default: "Alert")
Used to communicate in-game errors, important notifications, etc. to the player. The message box operates modally, stopping progress until the player confirms.

method.name: save_file
method.description:
Saves game data to the specified slot.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • slot: Slot number to save to (0-8) • save_data: Game data dictionary to save
Save file names follow the 'file0~file8' format and are automatically saved according to [member saveDir] platform-specific paths.

method.name: load_file
method.description:
Loads game data from the specified slot.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • slot: Slot number to load from (0-8)
Save file names follow the 'file0~file8' format and are automatically loaded according to platform-specific paths.
Returns the loaded game data dictionary.

method.name: exists_file
method.description:
Checks if a save file exists in the specified slot.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • slot: Slot number to check (0-8)
Save file names follow the 'file0~file8' format and are automatically checked according to platform-specific paths.
Returns true if the file exists, false if it doesn't.

method.name: change_setting
method.description:
Changes a game setting value.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • setting_name: One of ("Master", "Music", "SFX", "border", "shake", "vfx", "locale") • value: Value to set ("Master", "Music", "SFX" are float; "border", "shake", "vfx" are bool; "locale" is String)
Setting changes are immediately reflected in related systems.

method.name: get_Music
method.description:
Returns the [AudioStreamPlayer] object of the currently playing background music.
Used for music control (stop, volume adjustment, fade, etc.).

method.name: get_battle_text_box
method.description:
Checks if the text box is active during battle.
Returns true if battle text is being displayed, false otherwise. Used for battle UI state management.

method.name: get_frist
method.description:
Checks if this is the first run.
Used to determine if the game is starting for the first time. Utilized for displaying tutorials, initial setup, etc.

method.name: get_fullscreen
method.description:
Checks the current fullscreen mode status.
Returns true if in fullscreen mode, false if in windowed mode. Used for screen mode UI updates.

method.name: get_player_in_menu
method.description:
Checks if the player is currently in a menu state.
Returns true if menus like inventory, settings, or dimensional box are open. Used for game pause and input processing branching.

method.name: get_player_kr
method.description:
Returns the player's KR (karma) value.
Used to implement Undertale's poison damage system. Higher KR values result in continuous damage over time.

method.name: get_player_position
method.description:
Returns the player's current position.
Returns the player character's 2D coordinates in the overworld as a Vector2. Used for camera tracking, collision detection, event triggers, etc.
May not be accurate, so use only for reference purposes.

method.name: get_player_text_box
method.description:
Checks if a player-related text box is active.
Returns true if dialogue, item use messages, etc. are being displayed. Used for text overlay management and input control.

method.name: get_scene_container
method.description:
Returns the game's main scene container.
Provides a reference to the root container node used for scene transitions, UI overlays, dynamic node addition, etc.

method.name: set_flag
method.description:
Sets a general game flag.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Flag key name • value: Value to set (bool, int, string, etc.)
Stored only in memory and recorded to file when the game is saved. Used to track event completion, quest progress, etc.

method.name: get_flag
method.description:
Retrieves a general game flag value.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Flag key name • defaultValue: Default value to return when flag doesn't exist
Used to track game progress, event completion status, etc. Returns [param defaultValue] if the flag doesn't exist.

method.name: set_g_flags
method.description:
Sets a global game flag.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Flag key name • value: Value to set
Special global flags distinct from general flags. Used to store important states like ending branches, hidden content, etc.

method.name: get_g_flags
method.description:
Retrieves a global game flag value.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Flag key name • defaultValue: Default value to return when flag doesn't exist
Special global flags distinct from general flags. Used for storing important game states or ending-related information.

method.name: save_flag
method.description:
Sets a flag and immediately saves it.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • key: Flag key name • value: Value to save
Unlike set_flag(), automatically records to save file after setting. Used when immediately saving important progress.

method.name: heal
method.description:
Heals the player by the specified amount.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • amt: Amount of HP to heal (positive value)
Cannot heal beyond maximum HP, and values of 0 or less are ignored. Used for item usage, save points, etc.

method.name: isMobile
method.description:
Checks if the current platform is mobile.
Returns true if running on Android mobile platform. Used for platform-specific UI adjustments and input processing branches.

method.name: save_settings
method.description:
Saves game settings to file.
Encrypts and saves volume settings, screen effect options, fullscreen mode, etc. to a separate file.
Automatically called when settings change to maintain settings.

method.name: toggle_fullscreen
method.description:
Toggles between fullscreen and windowed mode.
Switches to windowed mode if currently fullscreen, or to fullscreen if currently windowed. The fullscreen_toggled signal is emitted when the transition completes.

method.name: save
method.description:
Saves the current game state to file.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • room_name: Name of the room/scene to save (if empty string, uses current node name; in overworld, uses current room name)
Encrypts and saves player information, inventory, flags, position, etc. The saved signal is emitted when saving is complete.

method.name: resetgame
method.description:
Resets the game to its initial state.
Resets player stats, inventory, flags, etc. to default values. Called when starting a new game; save files are preserved.

method.name: true_resetgame
method.description:
Completely resets the game.
A more complete reset than resetgame(), initializing all game states except settings like global flags and save_file.

members.member:
Master list of all items that exist in the game.
Each element is an [Item] object, referenced through indices. Inventory, equipment, dimensional box, etc. store indices from this array.
Default items: • 0: Stick (weapon, ATK+0) • 1: Bandage (consumable, HP+10) • 2: Pie (consumable, HP+999)

The player's inventory items.
Can store up to 8 items, with each element being an index from [member item_list]. This array is modified during item usage, equipment changes, dimensional box transfers, etc.

Array storing items in the dimensional box.
Can store up to 10 items, with each element being an index from [member item_list].

Information about equipment currently equipped by the player.
• "weapon": [member item_list] index of equipped weapon • "armor": [member item_list] index of equipped armor
Default values: weapon=0(Stick), armor=1(Bandage) Player attack and defense are automatically recalculated when equipment changes.
Array storing phone call title list. Each index is used in [method Overworld.start_cellphone].
The player's name.
The player's attack power.
The player's defense power.
The player's current experience points.
The gold (G) owned by the player.
The player's current HP.
The number of monsters defeated by the player.
The player's level (LV).

The player's maximum HP.
Increases when leveling up and serves as the upper limit for current HP. Healing items cannot restore HP beyond this value.

Directory path for save files. Save files are stored with the name file9.
[b]Specific reserved words can be used to specify directory paths.[/b] • "$home": User home directory (e.g., C:/Users/[username]/) • "$appdata": Application data directory (e.g., C:/Users/[username]/AppData/Roaming/) Only one reserved word can be used at a time and cannot be combined with other reserved words.
Automatically configured per platform with the following formats: • Windows: C:/Users/[username]/UNDERTALE/file9 • Web/Mobile: user://file9 • Other: user://file9 (fallback)

Dictionary storing game settings.
• "Master": Master volume (0-100) • "Music": Background music volume (0-100) • "SFX": Sound effects volume (0-100) • "border": Whether to display screen border • "shake": Whether to use screen shake effects • "vfx": Whether to use visual effects • "locale": Language setting ("auto", "en", "ko")

Dictionary storing global variables.
Used to share data between scripts or store temporary states.

Overworld-related data saved by [method save]. Used to restore overworld state during scene transitions.
• room_name: Current room name • room: Overworld room path (scene path) • room_pos: Player position (Vector2)

Whether the player can currently move.
Automatically controlled during menus, battles, cutscenes, etc.

Represents the player's movement state. While [member player_can_move] is automatically controlled by the system, [member player_move] can be set manually.
Used to forcibly restrict movement.

Whether the player is in a menu state. [method get_player_in_menu] checks this value together. Used when manually setting menu state.
Used to forcibly block keyboard input.
File scan directory path used in debug mode. Scans files in the specified path and automatically adds them to dropdown menus. Primarily used during development to quickly load scene files.

signal.name: fullscreen_toggled
signal.description:
Signal emitted when fullscreen mode is toggled.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • to: The mode switched to (true=fullscreen, false=windowed)
Used when UI elements need to react to screen mode changes. Automatically emitted after calling [method toggle_fullscreen].

signal.name: saved
signal.description:
Signal emitted when game saving is completed.
Triggered when save file writing succeeds after calling [method save] or [method save_file] function. Used for save completion notifications, UI updates, auto-save systems, etc.
